local-gateway-preregistration.scope: bounded in-JVM request/response route semantics;HTTP transport excluded

error.message: request body is not valid JSON

local-gateway-preregistration.controls: Authentication signs original raw body and full mounted path. A valid nonce is consumed before malformed JSON or missing-field failures;bad signature consumes nothing. GET balance/card/client ignores parsed JSON content but authentication still verifies body. Health bypasses auth. Unknown path/method does not enter authenticated handler. Source lowercase exact enums and allowed details;Party A/B. Client/body defaults,account currency/deposit,card CRUD closed card,transfer+token wrapper,confirm/review/null actor,network banks/positions,audit since and time config views use shared ecosystem. Source approve nonempty string false settles a reviewed2500 transfer even though Boolean false rejects it;list/object truthiness retained. Time accept_sync shares source truthiness. Bounds for headers/bytes/JSON/query remain explicit;no HTTP server/foreign subprocess/DB.
